summary: Jonah is displeased with the Lord for His mercy upon the people—The Lord rebukes him.
meta_description: Jonah is displeased with the Lord for His mercy upon the people—The Lord rebukes him.

footnotes.note2_b: HEB relentest; i.e., Jonah knew that God could revoke the calamity decreed, but expected He would do so even without the repentance of the people.
footnotes.note11_c: TG Man, Natural, Not Spiritually Reborn.
